Time is exact in the harness: two independent runs of harness/render.mjs (dark, the tweet's loop), each from a cold start
794 frames before the loop's frame -30 (the warm-up, the whole previous loop with the lit card's paint and its seeded
dithering), wrote these frames; each pair is the same bytes. Run 1 is the full run whose frames the videos use, drawn
beside three other runs; run 2 is a run of its own that stopped at frame -25.
